anonymity_rule: Do not infer or seek actor identities, model families, effort levels, earlier drafts, or earlier review outcomes. Review only the supplied evidence.
learner_baseline: The learner is an ungrounded, unembodied 1.2B model. Assume zero bankable semantics, grammar, discourse, world knowledge, identity grounding, common sense, interface convention, or human childhood experience.

lesson_context.point: Actual Lesson 000 staged bootstrap: greeting, copular self-identification, affirmative and negative identity, Who, OR, and meeting reciprocity in the original gated order.
lesson_context.world_objective: The names Ninereeds, Taro, Emma, Bob, and Errol remain stable across the source presentation and its noncanonical drills.
lesson_context.structural_exception: L000 is the sole staged nonlexical exception and has zero vocabulary items.

review_requirements: Inspect every modeled turn, base and reserve exercise, mixed order, story turn, comprehension demonstration/test, intervention, replay, alarm, budget, and asset binding.
Inspect exact pixels when material; check named contrasts, full relation operands, transformation necessity, and whether zero crops remains correct.
Judge learner-facing language and machine-control learnability against the zero-convention baseline.
Check complete participant grounding and isolated affirmative, negative, W, OR, and reciprocity gates before mixed practice.
Check the eight pages are one persistent identity-verification event, with page 04 unresolved, page 08 the sole resolution, and correct Emma-initiates/Ninereeds-reciprocates direction.

Check narrative demonstrations avoid pages 04 and 05 as anchors, both checks use counterbalanced option order, and scored answers require retention of the accepted boundary rather than a demonstrated cadence or lexical clue.
Check all scored first-person learner output remains Ninereeds as Ninereeds.

Check TRAIN_MORE releases both frozen reserves and terminates every branch; PRESENT_AGAIN has one exact gate-to-presentation-and-fourth-base-retest mapping per gate; no live freestyle or undefined IDs remain.

Audit teacher-turn accounting: every demonstration replay and SHOW_CORRECT_OPTION action counts, base total is 90, every adaptive emission is counted, replay is frozen to the 90-turn base path, and the 220-turn cap/replay predicate are mechanically evaluable.
Check overall mastery, phase terminal rules, FINISH, ALARM_FREEZE, and budget exhaustion are total and mutually coherent.
Return revise for any non-waterproof defect with exact owning-stage repair; do not rewrite the lesson.
output_contract: Write exactly one JSON file matching ninereeds_sol_assembly_review_v1. Set lesson_sha256 to candidate_sha256 and visual_necessity explicitly.
